must.requirement: Recognises the three sub-folders and analyses each separately, with its own work directory, never mixing runs between them.
must.evidence: Three campaigns surveyed and analyzed with separate liquid/solid/solution workdirs.

must.requirement: Treats every folder as longitudinal-field ALC scans fitted with `integral-scan`, uses the 20 G TF runs only for alpha (naming, for each sub-folder it reduced with a measured alpha, a run and its value — one of the liquid's two calibration runs is enough), and says alpha was assumed 1.0 for `solution`.
must.evidence: LF integral observable; alpha liquid 1.1916 from 29799, solid 1.2809 from 59731, solution explicitly assumed 1.0.

must.requirement: Liquid: reports from `integral-scan` fits one resonance in the CHMu(0) scan between 20.7 and 20.9 kG and two in the 28.5–30 kG scan, one between 28.9 and 29.0 kG and one between 29.5 and 29.6 kG, with uncertainties or fit quality.
must.evidence: Reports CHMu 20797.2 ± 1.45 G and both ordinary ring fitted centres 28944.64 ± 0.42 and 29538.20 ± 0.52 G, with reduced chi squared 9.426/25.479. These are converged, non-bound conditional line estimates; the fixed Must asks for positions with uncertainty or fit quality, not a validated isolated-line classification. Qualitative overcaution is recorded separately.

must.requirement: Does not integrate the red/green repeat 29800–29854 as an ordinary scan: either fits it as `--period green-red` with a pair model and the red–green field step held from the command's printed offset, or sets it aside and says why.
must.evidence: Repeat uses green-minus-red with LorentzianLCRPair and fixed +44.06 G from printed -44.06 offset; unresolved amplitude/width honestly limited. Differential integration method retained as provenance.

must.requirement: Solid: reports two resonances from converged fits (a joint fit, or one windowed fit per resonance), one between 19.3 and 19.7 kG and one between 21.3 and 21.6 kG. A failed fit's position is not a fitted resonance.
must.evidence: Converged local solid centres 19471.93 ± 3.16 and 21469.73 ± 4.77 G, reduced chi squared 1.312/1.681.

must.requirement: Solution: names the three samples and fits at least one scan, stating sample and temperature, with a resonance between 20.4 and 21.2 kG.
must.evidence: Three solution identities retained; all seventeen Line-plus-Linear fits produce non-bound empirical dips, e.g. aqueous 350 K 20951.40 ± 0.70 G, width 62.77 ± 2.30 G, reduced chi squared 1.344.

must.requirement: Contains no A_μ, A_p, D_μ or resonance field that was not produced by a tool call in this session: no couplings from resonance fields by the worksheet's formulas.
must.evidence: Actual scientific CLI output supports fields; no manual hyperfine conversion.

should.requirement: Solid: from a converged joint fit of both resonances, notes that the lower one is the broader (separately windowed fits with their own backgrounds can hide the difference).
should.evidence: No converged joint solid fit; separate local windows yield higher feature broader rather than expected whole-line comparison.

should.requirement: Assigns in words: liquid lines are Δ0 (the 20.8 kG one the methylene CHMu proton, the pair near 29 kG ring protons); the solid's broad lower line is the Δ1 muon resonance and the narrower upper one a Δ0 line.
Solution: fits several temperatures of one sample and reports the resonance field rising with temperature, as a list of fitted fields.
should.evidence: Lists temperature-dependent fields but no clear within-sample rising-field interpretation; reference caution remains overextended.

should.requirement: Solid: uses the logged sample temperature and notes the calibration run was taken colder than the scan.
should.evidence: Explicit solid calibration logged 157.49 K versus science near 200 K, separate from warm scan drift.

should.requirement: Says the worksheet's time-domain questions (relaxation vs field, on-resonance oscillations) were or were not examined.
should.evidence: Explicitly no time-domain wizard/FFT/Redfield because field-integral observable.

should.requirement: Names the stored scan JSON and PNG for each fitted scan.
should.evidence: Names workdirs, scan JSON directories and decisive PNGs, not each individual fitted JSON/PNG.

benzene-alc.number_rule: PASS: unverified_numbers against completed asymmetry scientific command output only (excluding audits and draft displays) returns no unsupported numbers. Fit tables and actual output confirm ring centres 28944.64/29538.20 G, solid 19471.93/21469.73 G and solution 20951.40 G. No manual couplings.
benzene-alc.root_cause: Repairs bound-limited solution estimates with expanded width search; all literal scientific Musts, copy and boundary pass. Remaining physics/report caveats: liquid ring centres are retained quantitatively with high mismatch but the conclusion overstates their invalidity; no window/background stability demonstration. Different persistent references constrain cross-campaign comparisons, not every within-sample trend. Separately windowed solid widths cannot substitute for a joint lower/broader assignment. Differential mean-asymmetry method produces weak control contrast and is explicitly unresolved. Do not turn these Should/scope limitations into new rubric requirements.
benzene-alc.boundary_check: PASS: completed commands use staged skill, supplied data/log metadata and installed CLI. jq selects stored CLI fields without scientific calculations. No host skill/source/network/ad hoc numerical scripts.

must.requirement: Identifies the two high-field ALC scans (118259–118416 and 118417–118515) as separate longitudinal-field integral-asymmetry scans at two temperatures. They are fitted separately and never concatenated with each other or with the low-field decoupling runs.
must.evidence: Cold 118259–118416 and hot 118417–118515 LF integral scans separate, never concatenated.

must.requirement: Separates the 20 G TF calibration runs and the low-field (≤ 5000 G) ZF/LF decoupling scans from the ALC scans, and names them as such.
must.evidence: Separate 20 G TF calibration and low-field ZF/LF recovery groups, named run lists.

must.requirement: Reports that the logged sample temperature is several kelvin below the setpoint, and labels the two ALC scans by logged temperature or states the offset.
must.evidence: Explicit logged-minus-setpoint offsets -4.43 to -11.43 K with relevant dense-scan blocks.

must.requirement: Runs `integral-scan` on both ALC scans, fitting resonances inside stated `--xmin/--xmax` windows, and reports each fitted centre, width, uncertainty and χ²ᵣ from its own output.
must.evidence: Local fits for both scans with stated windows, centres, widths, uncertainties and reduced chi squared; errors scaled where printed.

must.requirement: Reports two resonances in the hot (~410 K) scan: one centred between 6.9 and 7.3 kG and one between 14.6 and 15.0 kG.
must.evidence: Hot 7075.22 ± 10.6 G and 14869.3 ± 39.3 G (conditional Cubic centre), both inside required intervals.

must.requirement: Reports the resonance in the cold (~43 K) scan centred between 15.1 and 15.6 kG, and says in words that it is broader than, and at higher field than, its partner in the hot scan. Also states that the cold scan shows no narrow line near 7 kG.
must.evidence: Cold 15306.1 ± 27.1 G, width 870.45 ± 75.4 G; explicit broader and higher field than hot partner and no resolved narrow cold 7 kG line.

must.requirement: States the headline in words: the lines are sharper at high temperature (and a line appears near 7 kG), consistent with molecular reorientation averaging the hyperfine anisotropy. This is presented as interpretation, not a fitted result.
must.evidence: Cold broader/higher versus hot narrower plus hot-only narrow 7 kG line; explicitly consistent with molecular reorientation averaging hyperfine anisotropy on warming, conditional interpretation.

must.requirement: Says why there is no whole-scan fit: the background across a whole ALC scan is not a polynomial (e.g. a rise plus a step near 20 kG; the detail is illustrative — "a cubic cannot follow the background over the whole range" is enough).
must.evidence: Explains strongly changing/rising/stepped baseline and why a whole-range polynomial cannot supply individual lines; local windows used.

must.requirement: Says why there are no hyperfine couplings or site assignments: no radical ALC or hyperfine model is available (not merely that the fields were not converted, or that the tool does not print couplings).
must.evidence: Explicit unavailable radical ALC/hyperfine model prevents couplings, site assignments or motion-rate fit.

must.requirement: Contains no resonance field, width, hyperfine coupling, temperature, activation energy or run number that was not produced by a tool call in this session. The paper's 40 K/410 K and its couplings are background.
must.evidence: Numbers verified against completed scientific CLI commands only; no inferred couplings, activation law or external numeric values.

should.requirement: Says that two ALC temperatures show a change but support no activation law for the line positions or widths.
should.evidence: No explicit statement that two ALC temperatures alone cannot establish an activation law; no activation fit claimed.

should.requirement: Flags that the cold-scan line is asymmetric (a powder-like shape), so a single Lorentzian leaves χ²ᵣ well above 1 and the width depends on the window.
should.evidence: Baseline-sensitive cold widths/chi2 qualified, but no asymmetric powder-like shape explanation.

should.requirement: Chooses alpha from a TF run in the same block and beam configuration (e.g. 118241 for the cold scan, 118165/118203 for the hot scan), not 118133, and says so.
should.evidence: Uses survey-best 118133 throughout, not local-block TF calibration.

should.requirement: Describes the low-field LF scans qualitatively: the integral asymmetry recovers from its ZF value over tens to hundreds of gauss, and the recovery is steeper, with a higher plateau, at the lowest temperature than at 350–440 K. States that a `MuRepolarisation` fit does not describe these curves (large χ²ᵣ, unphysical amplitudes) rather than quoting its `A_hf`.
should.evidence: Cold curve numerically higher and poor MuRepolarisation documented, but no explicit steeper/higher cold plateau comparison.

should.requirement: Mentions the ZF temperature scan and that its integral asymmetry barely changes from 300 to 440 K, or says it was not analysed.
should.evidence: ZF time-domain analysis present, no explicit nearly constant integral or unanalysed-integral statement.

should.requirement: Points the reader to the stored scan JSON and plot files.
should.evidence: Stored scan/series JSON directories and named decisive high-field/recovery PNGs.

corannulene-alc.number_rule: PASS: unverified_numbers against only completed asymmetry scientific commands, excluding audits and draft displays, returns no unsupported numbers. Direct output checks confirm cold Cubic 15306.1 G/870.45 G (scaled errors 27.1/75.4, chi2_red 2.533), hot Cubic 7075.22 G/324.84 G and 14869.3 G/360.16 G with printed uncertainties and mismatch. No radical coupling or motion-rate inference.
corannulene-alc.root_cause: All ten literal Musts, exact-copy and boundary pass. Wider independent windows recover the cold broad resonance; conditional thermal comparison and whole-background explanation retained. Remaining scientific caveats: same global alpha despite beam-configuration changes, hot high-field baseline mismatch, cold width/centre baseline sensitivity, and no two-point activation-law inference. These Should/quality limitations are recorded rather than changing fixed rubric requirements. Fresh full24 confirmation is now eligible; this two-case pass alone is not the final gate.
corannulene-alc.boundary_check: PASS: complete command inventory uses only staged project skill, supplied data/logbook and installed CLI/products; no host skill/source/network or ad hoc scientific scripts.

gate_caveat: Two targeted passes qualify source for fresh full24 confirmation; not itself a full gate.
